title: ThreatAssessment senior verdict (threat_assessment.v1)
description: Story 3.7 structured Senior verdict (FR24). AUTHORITATIVE validation source for the Senior sub-agent response contract; threat_assessment.yaml is the human-readable mirror and internal/decision/analyst/threat_assessment_schema.json is the byte-identical embedded runtime copy. This is the MODEL-facing verdict schema: the persisted schema.ThreatAssessment struct additionally carries the orchestrator-computed raw_confidence/llm_capped_confidence pair, agents_available, and the Story 3.11 ConfidenceScore fold. schema_version is optional (or null) on the model side: the runner force-stamps threat_assessment.v1 after validation. Whitespace-only threat_type, reasoning and noted_disagreements entries are rejected programmatically by the runner. confidence is the RAW model confidence; capping at the per-provider score cap is orchestrator-side (AC2). Size bounds follow the Story 3.5 round-1 convention.

schema_version.description: Stamped to threat_assessment.v1 by the runner; optional (or null) from the model.

threat_type.description: Short classification of the assessed activity (e.g. crypto_miner, benign_operations).

reasoning.description: The Senior's challenge-driven reasoning over the evidence, L1 hypothesis and L2 verification.

mitre_techniques.description: ATT&CK technique annotations (FR24); optional because a benign verdict may carry none.

noted_disagreements.description: Explicit disagreements between L1 and L2 the Senior records (FR24); preserved for audit.

confidence.description: RAW Senior confidence in [0,100]; the orchestrator caps it at the per-provider score cap.
